summary: Firefox improved how it chooses and manages media decoders and encoders across Android, Linux, Windows, and macOS. The changes make hardware video support and its limits—such as frame size and color depth—more accurately detected, while improving Android MediaCodec and FFmpeg handling for H.264 and HEVC, including bitrate changes. Linux Vulkan Video compatibility and low-latency playback also received fixes, helping video work more reliably across different devices and drivers.
